facts.claim: PhonePe earns merchant interchange of 0.5% to 1.1% on eligible flows, with lending distribution at 11.55% of first-half FY26 revenue
facts.source_title: PhonePe IPO India 2026: Valuation, OFS Structure, NPCI Cap Risk
facts.excerpt: PhonePe's revenue comes from merchant interchange (0.5%-1.1% on eligible flows), device subscriptions, bill-payment commissions and lending distribution at 11.55% of H1 FY26 revenue.

facts.claim: UPI runs on zero merchant discount rate as a national policy decision
facts.source_title: PhonePe IPO India 2026: Valuation, OFS Structure, NPCI Cap Risk
facts.excerpt: UPI operates on zero MDR, a policy decision made at the national level, which constrains direct payment transaction monetization.

facts.claim: India's leading UPI app earns roughly 112 rupees of gross revenue per registered user per year
facts.source_title: PhonePe IPO India 2026: Valuation, OFS Structure, NPCI Cap Risk
facts.excerpt: The category leader generates approximately Rs 112 of gross revenue per registered user per year.

facts.claim: Indian in-app purchase spending passed 1 billion dollars in 2025 and is expected to reach 1.25 billion by the end of 2026
facts.excerpt: In-app purchase spending by Indians passed one billion dollars in 2025, expected to rise to $1.25 billion by the end of 2026.

facts.claim: From 1 January 2026 Apple replaced the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital-goods revenue
facts.source_title: App Store Fees and Commission Rates in 2026
facts.excerpt: From January 1, 2026, Apple replaced the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital-goods revenue.

facts.claim: Google Play's 2026 standard rate is 10% on the first 1 million dollars of annual revenue and 20% above it
facts.source_title: Google Play External Payments and Fee Changes
facts.excerpt: Google lowered its baseline: the standard rate is now 10% on the first $1 million and 20% above it, plus a billing fee charged separately.
